radovi.title:
Sites we have
worked on.
radovi.lead: Three properties, three different scopes — from a one-page calling card to a system with bookings and calendar sync. Click through to see the site exactly as a guest sees it.

i1.d: Three flats, four languages and a real booking system with card payment. The site comes with an owner's panel and calendar sync with Booking.com and Airbnb.

i2.d: Two flats in the same building in Petrčane near Zadar. Garden and terrace, balcony, free parking and direct enquiries — no middlemen, no commission.

i3.d: A flat with a terrace and a sea view on the Pelješac peninsula. Gallery, seasonal price list, map and contact — all on one fast page.
